Introduction

This Bachelor of Nursing (Top-Up) course is designed to enable Registered Nurses (RNs) with a diploma qualification in nursing to expand their professional education to a bachelor’s degree.  This nursing degree consists of core studies and subjects relevant to the context of nursing practice in Singapore.

Students are assisted to expand their knowledge base in the discipline of nursing and apply this knowledge to nursing practice. They are also provided with the opportunity to develop academic and practical skills, and the attitudes needed to comprehend and evaluate new nursing knowledge in the discipline of nursing.

Course Highlights

  • Accredited by Singapore Nursing Board

    This course is under the list of accredited Nursing Education Programmes by the Singapore Nursing Board.

  • Nursing Scholarship

    PSB Academy and La Trobe University awards 2 Nursing Scholarship annually with no bond requirements for students who applied for the Bachelor of Nursing (Top- Up) programme. T&Cs apply.

  • 100% Coursework Based

    The Nursing Degree programme is 100% coursework based. Students will be graded on assignments and project work basis.

  • Learn from Subject Experts

    Learn from our experienced academic team and fly-in lecturers from La Trobe University

Industry Collaboration

Nurses Learning Hub by Singapore Nurses Association

As a subsidiary of Singapore Nurses Association, the Nurses Learning Hub (NLH) strives to be recognised as a quality tertiary education provider, nurturing and developing leaders in nursing with a global mindset. This initiative is aligned to one of Singapore Nurses Association’s objectives – to promote the advancement of nurses in education. NLH is committed to providing quality programmes that broaden nurses’ knowledge base and scope of practice, engaging them in lifelong learning to maintain clinical competencies to meet the demands of a dynamic health care system.

Further Studies and Career Pathways

Completing a Bachelor of Nursing (Top-up) can open up broader professional and academic opportunities within the healthcare sector.

Graduates may pursue:

  • Advanced clinical or leadership roles within healthcare institutions
  • Opportunities in nursing education, research, or healthcare management
  • Postgraduate pathways, such as the Master of Nursing (Leadership) at La Trobe University, subject to entry requirements
  • Expanded roles in specialised or community-based nursing settings

This degree can provide a strong foundation for nurses planning long-term career development and further academic progression.

Duration

Duration: 24 months

Lesson Duration: Average of 2-3 hours per session

Terms: 2 modules in a semester 

Learning Mode

Blended (In-Campus & Online)

Modules

Academic Year 1 Modules

  • Education in Health Professional Practice 
  • Healthcare Ethics and Law 
  • Primary Healthcare in Nursing and Midwifery
  • Professional Practice Nurse Transition

Academic Year 2 Modules 

  • Applied Evidenced Based Care in Nursing and Midwifery
  • Leadership and Clinical Governance in Nursing and Midwifery
  • Nursing Patients with Chronic Illness 

Mode of Assessment

Assessment of this programme may include assignments, tests, projects, reports, lab work and others. 

Intakes

  • February
  • August

Minimum Class Size 

  • 20 students to commence class 

Graduation Requirements

Upon successful completion of all required modules, students will be awarded the Bachelor of Nursing from La Trobe University. The degree awarded will be the same as that to the on-campus graduates. 

Maximum Candidature

84 months upon start of the programme 

  • Part-Time

Academic Requirements

  • Applicants must hold a minimum three-year nursing certificate or diploma in nursing from a La Trobe approved and recognised nursing school or tertiary education institution.
  • Applicants need to have a current registration (full or conditional) with Singapore Nursing Board (SNB) as a Registered Nurse.
  • Students must be employed as registered nurses and hold a valid practising certificate (full or conditional registration) from the SNB and work in approved health care or nursing education organisation for the duration of the course.

All applications are subject to approval by La Trobe University.

Minimum Age Requirement

  • 18 years old

English Language Requirement

The course is conducted in English and to successfully complete the degree students need to be competent in communicating in English (writing, reading, listening and speaking). As such, applicants who completed their pre-registration nursing education in a language other than English must provide evidence of their proficiency in the English language; namely an International English Language Test score (IELTs) of at least 6.5 with no band less than 6.0, or approved equivalent.

English language test scores must be less than two years old at the date of application to La Trobe University. As such, applicants who completed their pre-registration nursing education in a language other than English must provide evidence of their proficiency in the English language; namely an International English Language Test score (IELTs) of at least 6.5 with no band less than 6.0, or approved equivalent.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • How does this Bachelor of Nursing (Top-Up) differ from a full-time nursing degree in Singapore?

    This top-up nursing degree is designed specifically for Registered Nurses who hold a recognised Nursing Diploma and are registered with the Singapore Nursing Board. Instead of completing the full duration of a traditional programme, eligible nurses progress into the later stage of the bachelor’s programme. This pathway allows qualified Nursing Diploma holders to upgrade their academic qualifications without repeating foundational nursing training.

  • Can this top-up degree in nursing help support progression into leadership roles?

    This nursing degree programme builds on existing clinical experience by integrating case studies, research-informed academic theories, and applied professional knowledge. It is designed to deepen critical thinking, evidence-based practice, and analytical skills relevant to contemporary healthcare settings. Combined with workplace experience, this academic upgrade may support progression into broader clinical, supervisory, or education-related responsibilities, depending on organisational requirements.

  • Can I work while studying this nursing course in Singapore?

    Yes. This programme is offered on a part-time basis to support working Registered Nurses. The majority of lessons are conducted online each trimester, with no more than 2 to 3 in-person sessions per trimester. Physical lesson schedules are provided in advance to help nurses plan around their work commitments.

  • Can I pursue further studies after completing this Bachelor of Nursing?

    Yes. Upon completion of the Bachelor of Nursing, graduates may pursue further studies, subject to meeting the entry requirements of the respective programme and institution. Progression options depend on individual academic performance and institutional criteria.
